text:
marco: Quick notes from a tiny prototype experiment — call it proposer-verifier rollforward (PVR). We run a lightweight proposer (3B q4) to speculative-emit tokens and a heavyweight verifier (70B q8) only when proposer confidence is low. logging + early bench below.

anya: nice. what's the gating metric? how do you make it robust across short/long contexts?

marco: we used a calibrated confidence = softmax_top1 / (entropy_median_model + epsilon). more concretely: conf = exp(logit1)/(sum_exp) / (median_entropy + 1e-6). calibrate median_entropy on a 2k calibration set per model. threshold is route-configurable. aim for ~90% token acceptance.

devon: do we reuse KV to avoid recomputing prefix when verifier runs? that makes or breaks latency.

marco: yes, verifier reuses prefix KV; when verifier is triggered we only run logits for the candidate token(s). we tried 1-token verify vs 2-token lookahead; 2-token lowers false negatives but costs more.

sylvie: paste bench command and numbers? short summary is fine.

marco: ```
# quick bench (dev cluster)
python infra/bench_decode.py \n  --model=redwood/70b-base-q8 \n  --proposer=local/3b-q4 \n  --gating=softmax_over_median_entropy \n  --threshold=0.12 \n  --batch=4 \n  --seq_len=1024 \ 
  --profile
```

marco: summary (mean of 3 runs, 20k toks):
- baseline (70B q8 no spec): p50=220ms/token, p95=430ms/token, cost=100 units per 1M tokens
- PVR (3B proposer + verifier): p50=85ms/token, p95=210ms/token, cost~42 units per 1M tokens
- acceptance ~88% (1-token verify)
- head-to-head (HH-RLHF 1k) win-rate vs baseline = 49.2% (no significant loss), average delta logprob = -0.015

ops-bot: bench-job pvr_infra started (k8s job 2026-03-21_09:10)

anya: p95 looks pretty good. any clear failure modes?

marco: observed a couple: 1) long-context extractive summarization often had dropped facts when proposer was overconfident; 2) code completions with rare symbols sometimes failed to trigger verifier because token-wise conf looked ok; 3) domain-shift prompts (legalese) had lower acceptance.

marco: quick example (long meeting notes):
- proposer (3B q4): "Summary: the team agreed to accelerate timeline, start user testing, and discuss partner handoff next week."
- verifier (70B): "Summary: the team identified three blockers: infra quota, outstanding security review, and contract terms with partner Z. action: schedule security review and partner alignment meeting."

marco: proposer omitted blockers; gate allowed it ~2.8% of steps.

devon: mitigation ideas: context-aware threshold (increase threshold with context length), force-verifier every N tokens (e.g., 64), and a moving-average confidence drift detector to trigger early fallbacks.

marco: implemented context-aware threshold: threshold *= (1 + 0.4 * min(context_len/2048, 1.0)). this reduced missed-fact cases but acceptance fell to 84%. tradeoff as expected.

sylvie: infra checklist: 1) run PVR across proposer quant levels (3b q4 vs 3b q8) 2) run on dedicated pool with batch 1/2/4 for realistic p95 3) capture per-route win-rate traces for Console. I'll queue those.

anya: eval plan: holdouts = HH-RLHF 1k, LongSumm 600, CodeGen 600. metrics = human AB win-rate, pass@1 for code, extractive recall for summaries, delta logprob. additionally log acceptance by token index and by prompt category.

marco: will add a JSONL diff dump when verifier overwrites a proposer token: include prompt id, proposer_token, verifier_token, gating_conf, context_len, and position. small sample saved for human review.

devon: edge case: tokenization drift between proposer and verifier (same tokenizer but quantization implementation differences). add assert that proposer.tokens(prefix) == verifier.tokens(prefix) before reusing KV; fallback to full verify if mismatch.

marco: added token alignment check + unit tests that randomize quant stack to trigger mismatch.

ops-bot: scheduled: eng-ml/dedicated-pvr-run-6987654321 (ETA 4h)

sylvie: monitoring: add metrics spec.accept_rate, spec.accept_by_pos, spec.verifier_trips, and spec.human_delta_winrate per route. raise pager if accept_rate < 75% for >5m or human_delta_winrate < -0.06 after 24h.

anya: also add an offline regression that replays failed diffs through a small human panel for rapid checks. good to capture where proposer confidently drops key facts.

marco: TL;DR: proposer-verifier rollforward gives ~2.5x token-cost reduction in these dev runs with strong p50 wins and decent p95. quality impact concentrated in low-entropy long-context or rare-token cases; mitigations (context-aware thresholds, periodic forced-verifier) reduce regressions at the cost of lower acceptance. Opening WIP PR with code, eval harness, and README on threshold defaults and tuning. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/YYY (draft).

devon: next: run matrix of (proposer q4/q8) x (verify window 1/2 tokens) x (thresholds 0.08/0.12/0.16) and push traces to Console for route-specific tuning.

sylvie: assigning: @marco -> PR + diffs, @devon -> token-alignment tests + bench matrix, @anya -> eval protocol + human panel plan. will create JIRA and calendar. :spiral_calendar_paged:

marco: thanks — I'll update when dedicated runs are in.
